skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students will be able to read and understand academic texts at a C1 level according to the Common European Framework of Reference.
Students will develop a rich academic vocabulary through reading materials and exercises.
Students will learn effective note-taking techniques for academic purposes.
Students will enhance their ability to analyze, evaluate, connect, synthesize information, and think logically.

Students will improve their comprehension skills by engaging with various academic topics such as sociology, art history, anthropology, science and technology, political science, medical science, literature, history, business, and migration studies.
